mapper.select:
SELECT shs.id AS summary_id, op.incident_id, shs.operational_period_id AS op_id, shs.duty_shift_id, shs.generation_status, shs.content, shs.source_data_hash, shs.source_readiness, shs.generated_at, shs.version FROM search_history_summary shs JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = shs.operational_period_id WHERE shs.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND shs.source_data_hash <> #{sourceDataHash} AND shs.source_readiness = 'READY' AND shs.generation_status IN ('READY', 'FAILED')
AND shs.duty_shift_id = #{dutyShiftId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
AND shs.duty_shift_id IS NULL
ORDER BY shs.created_at ASC, shs.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_history_summary ( id, operational_period_id, duty_shift_id, generation_status, content, source_data_hash, source_readiness, requested_by_account_id, generated_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{summaryId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{dutyShiftId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{generationStatus}, #{content}, #{sourceDataHash}, #{sourceReadiness}, #{requestedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{generatedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE search_history_summary SET generation_status = #{generationStatus}, content = #{content}, source_readiness = #{sourceReadiness}, generated_at = #{generatedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{summaryId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
